test.name: restore drill: an old backup restored and started; both clients name rolled-back, hand back their newer checkpoints and re-push; the next checkpoint covers every client's heads, recomputes nested and nobody sees a forked view
restore drill: the cold backup and the live state folder hold no byte of the hub's signing or encryption key (D-30)
each hub is a StatefulSet of one with the Compose hardening, its secret files and its own volume
two hubs in a site render two StatefulSets with their own volumes, and no Ingress routes to any hub
sessions reach a hub by its cluster address and members by its node port, both plain TCP to the hub's own TLS
the hubs' certificates come from site-pki-hub and no Ingress routes to a hub
